bundle.longDescription: DiskPilot is open-source storage intelligence for Windows. It scans your drives read-only, explains what is using space and why, and only ever removes files through a reviewed plan that passes a strict safety gate — to the Recycle Bin by default.
bundle.shortDescription: Understand your storage. Know what is safe. Clean it confidently.
